name: Ashtoreth
overview: Ashtoreth was a prominent idol worshiped by the Philistines, Zidonians, and Phoenicians, and was also adopted by the Israelites, leading them away from the LORD as seen in Judges 2:13 and 10:6. The Bible associates Ashtoreth with the 'queen of heaven,' to whom the people made offerings, provoking God's anger (Jeremiah 7:18). The prophets called God's people to repent by removing Ashtoreth and other foreign gods from their midst and serving the LORD alone, as Samuel urged in 1 Samuel 7:3-4. The destruction of high places dedicated to Ashtoreth, including those in Jerusalem, underscores the necessity of forsaking idolatry to remain faithful to God.
